title: Minimax Conditional Law Estimation When Treated-Arm Design Mass Vanishes Polynomially

gap_reasons: The final theorem delivers matching upper and all-procedure lower bounds, including the critical logarithm; the headline exact-order claim is not contingent on an unresolved conjecture. The unconditional 2/5 power is established in [Stéphanovitch–Aamari–Levrard, Theorem 4.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2311.18613v2), and the fixed-overlap conditional exponent appears in [GANICE, Theorems 2–3](https://arxiv.org/html/2605.10206v1), so neither is independently novel here. The contribution is the depletion-dependent frontier, its exact critical logarithm, and an observable mixture-robust estimator with a normalized multivariate converse. Its significance remains confined to a one-dimensional uniform-target benchmark with prescribed depletion geometry and fixed latent smoothness and dimensions. The coded estimator has exponential enumeration cost, and no efficient implementation or application is delivered, limiting its practical econometric reach. Precise citations for the unproved classical entropy and concentration leaves and explicit theorem-level comparisons with the listed regression literature remain documentation gaps; restricted breadth and computational usefulness constrain the projected paper score after editorial repair. tldr:
The identified causal conditional-law family has the exact all-regime minimax frontier
\[
 R_n(\alpha,\gamma)\asymp
 n^{-r(\alpha,\gamma)}\{\log(\mathrm e n)\}^{\mathbf1\{\gamma=\gamma_c(\alpha)\}},
 \qquad
 r(\alpha,\gamma)=\min\left\{\frac{2\alpha}{5\alpha+2},\frac{2(\alpha+1)}{5\alpha+2+2\gamma}\right\},
 \qquad\gamma_c(\alpha)=\frac52+\frac1\alpha.
\]
The total original-data estimator \(\widehat\mu_\star\), using arm-specific constant-threshold count trees and a finite coded density-free law sieve, attains this order under unknown measurable treatment depletion. Normalized multivariate transport cubes give the matching same-class converse for every randomized procedure. A logarithm is necessary and sufficient exactly at the interior/boundary transition; there is no logarithmic factor in the minimax order away from it.
gap: Bounded-overlap causal generation and manifold distribution regression provide nearby conditional-law theories. Neither inspected result characterizes the supplied uniform-target risk under measurable spatial treatment depletion on the entire general smooth-pushforward class.
fill: A multiscale original-data estimator and a same-class transport testing family would determine the largest attainable polynomial exponent and the boundary/interior transition without propensity estimation or a network-training transfer premise.
